g.text: JP1 (one shunt): 1-2 USB/LDO powers +3V3, 2-3 MSP-FET VCC_TOOL powers +3V3.

g.desc: JP1 (one shunt): 1-2 USB/LDO powers +3V3, 2-3 MSP-FET VCC_TOOL powers +3V3.

g.text: JP2 off = measure the MCU alone. Firmware: XCAPx = 00 for Y1 with C10/C11.
